defaults.composition: A broad open highland view with clear foreground, middle ground and background

shots.subject: A high granite plateau dusted with the first snow, a shallow dark tarn rimmed with thin ice, snow-capped tussocks and a low bank of cloud resting below the distant ridges
shots.composition: Eye-level view straight across the flat plateau, the tarn lying as a long dark band across the lower third, snowy tussocks in front of it and the cloud bank with the ridges along the far horizon
shots.motion_elements: the low cloud bank and the open water of the tarn

shots.subject: A rounded mountain shoulder of rust-muted rust autumn grass and bilberry, a few dwarf pines and a sea of clouds filling the valleys far below with blue ridge tops standing out of it
shots.composition: From high on the shoulder looking down about 40 degrees, the red slope filling the lower half, the cloud sea spreading across the middle and the ridge tops emerging along the top third
shots.motion_elements: the sea of clouds and the autumn grass

shots.subject: A rolling heather moorland on a high saddle in autumn, dark peat banks, russet heather mounds and thin mist moving across the far slopes
shots.composition: Camera low among the heather, one russet heather mound filling the lower third of the frame, the saddle rolling away behind it and mist-veiled slopes in the background
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist and the heather stems

shots.subject: Five or six rounded highland ridges in receding layers, the nearest dark autumn-brown and the farthest pale blue, with valley fog lying between each layer
shots.composition: Long telephoto view with no foreground, compressing the ridges into stacked horizontal bands from the dark near ridge to the palest far ridge, fog bands separating them
shots.motion_elements: the fog bands between the ridges

shots.subject: A dry late-summer upland of pale feather grass, a single gnarled pine on a low rise and tall cumulus clouds catching warm evening light
shots.composition: Horizon set low in the bottom third, the lone pine small on the right third of the horizon line, the sky with towering lit clouds filling the upper 60 percent of the frame
shots.motion_elements: the slow cumulus clouds and the feather grass

shots.subject: A snow-dusted plateau edge at the treeline, two low wind-twisted krummholz spruces, a pale snowy basin beyond and gray low cloud on the far hills
shots.composition: The dark twisted spruces fill the left and right edges of the frame, the gap between them opening onto the snowy basin in the middle ground and the cloud-capped hills behind
shots.motion_elements: the low cloud and the spruce twigs

shots.subject: A worn natural footpath of bare earth and stones running along the crest of a long rounded grassy ridge in autumn, tawny grass on both flanks and far hills under scattered clouds
shots.composition: Standing on the crest looking along the path as it runs away into the distance, slopes falling away to the left and right, distant hills and sky beyond the end of the ridge
shots.motion_elements: the cloud shadows on the far hills and the tawny grass

shots.subject: A high moor with a cluster of stacked granite tors on a low summit, rain-darkened rock, sun-bleached summer grass and clouds lifting off a long far escarpment
shots.composition: Eye-level from the side across the moor, the tor cluster on the left third of the skyline, open grass across the middle ground and the escarpment along the right horizon
shots.motion_elements: the lifting clouds and the moor grass

shots.subject: A wide blanket bog on a flat upland, a maze of dark peat pools edged with white cotton grass, scattered erratic boulders and a wall of mist crossing the middle distance
shots.composition: From a low rise looking down about 30 degrees onto the pattern of dark pools, which fill the lower two thirds of the frame, the mist wall stretched across the top
shots.motion_elements: the crossing mist and the cotton grass heads

shots.subject: A grey scree fan of loose angular stones with small meltwater trickles running between them, spreading below a broad, smoothly rounded grassy summit, old snow patches lying in the hollows, a broad empty corrie beyond and low cloud along its rounded rim
shots.composition: Camera low on the scree, angular gray stones filling the lower third, the snow-patched corrie floor across the middle and the cloud-capped rim along the top
shots.motion_elements: the low cloud along the rim and thin meltwater trickles between the stones

shots.subject: Distant hillsides where dark pines thin out into open moor, rust bracken patches between the trees and mist banks lying in layers
shots.composition: Telephoto view across the valley with no foreground, the pine-dotted slopes stacked as overlapping planes and mist bands separating each plane
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist bands

shots.subject: A windswept tundra plateau with pale lichen fields, a small round lake and a distant dark massif under long streaks of thin high cloud
shots.composition: Horizon low across the frame, the round lake a small bright oval left of center on the plateau, streaked clouds filling the upper 55 percent of the frame
shots.motion_elements: the wind-ruffled lake surface and the thin high clouds

shots.subject: A narrow gap between two weathered granite tor stacks on a summit plateau, old snow lying in the gap and a wide brown moorland basin with a winding peat stream beyond
shots.composition: Rough granite stacks fill the left and right edges of the frame, the snowy gap in the lower middle opening onto the moorland basin and its stream in the center
shots.motion_elements: the peat stream and thin drifting cloud over the basin

shots.subject: A high moorland basin in autumn with a peaty brook looping across the floor, purple-brown heather, gray boulders and pine-dotted hills beyond
shots.composition: Eye-level across the basin from its edge, the brook looping horizontally through the middle ground, a band of heather in front and the hills along the horizon
shots.motion_elements: the flowing brook and the heather

shots.subject: A faint grassy footpath winding down a rounded hill to a wide saddle, a thin uneven dusting of first snow lying in patches with plenty of golden grass showing through everywhere, in low golden sun
shots.composition: From the hilltop looking down about 35 degrees, the path curving from the lower left down to the saddle in the middle ground, rounded snowy hills beyond
shots.motion_elements: the high drifting clouds and the grass tips in the snow

shots.subject: A dry summer plateau of pale golden tussock grass, a big tussock near the camera, a flat open expanse and a long escarpment under fair-weather cumulus
shots.composition: Camera at ground level, the large tussock filling the lower left third, the flat plateau stretching behind it and the escarpment along the horizon
shots.motion_elements: the tussock blades and the cumulus clouds

shots.subject: A row of rounded summits capped with the first snow above brown autumn-worn slopes, the snow line sharp across the hills and low cloud drifting along it
shots.composition: Medium telephoto view with no foreground, compressing the summits into overlapping domes, the snow line running horizontally across all of them
shots.motion_elements: the low cloud along the snow line

shots.subject: A broad plateau rim with patches of old snow under a huge pale dawn sky with long rows of high wave clouds, low rounded hills along the horizon
shots.composition: The hill horizon low in the frame, a thin strip of snowy rim along the bottom, the rows of high clouds filling more than half the frame
shots.motion_elements: the rows of high clouds drifting across the sky

shots.subject: Autumn larches in gold needles at the edge of a high plateau, tawny grass underfoot and a broad valley with hazy far ridges beyond
shots.composition: Golden larch trunks and hanging branches fill the left and right edges, the open valley and distant ridges seen through the gap in the center
shots.motion_elements: the larch branches and the tawny grass

shots.subject: A long open upland glen with a pale river winding along its floor between dry summer grass slopes and low cloud grazing the rounded tops
shots.composition: Looking straight down the length of the glen from its head, the river leading from the bottom center toward the far end, slopes rising on both sides
shots.motion_elements: the river and the low cloud

shots.subject: A wet late-winter treeline shelf with a band of low wind-shaped krummholz pines, melting snow patches, meltwater puddles and clouds breaking over a far ridge
shots.composition: Eye-level across the shelf, the dark krummholz band along the middle ground, snow patches and puddles in front and the ridge beyond
shots.motion_elements: the breaking clouds and the ripples on the puddles

shots.subject: A chain of three small tarns on a stepped plateau in autumn, rust grass and dark rock between them and mist rising from the valley beyond
shots.composition: From a rocky knoll looking down about 40 degrees, the tarns stepping from the lower left toward the center, the misty valley filling the top of the frame
shots.motion_elements: the rising mist and the tarn surfaces

shots.subject: A frost-shattered boulder field on a high plateau, fresh snow in the cracks between the stones and the field fading away into fog
shots.composition: Camera low against a big lichen-covered boulder in the lower right third, the boulder field receding into fog across the middle and a faint ridge behind
shots.motion_elements: the drifting fog

shots.subject: Long rolling moorland hills in late summer, dry gold grass with sunlit and shadowed patches as rain clouds clear from the distance
shots.composition: Telephoto view with no foreground, compressing three rolling moor hills into overlapping curves banded with sun and cloud shadow
shots.motion_elements: the cloud shadows sliding over the hills

shots.subject: A flat heather plateau in autumn bronze under a huge layered gray-blue overcast sky with one brighter band of light near the horizon
shots.composition: Horizon very low, a thin band of bronze heather across the bottom quarter and the layered overcast clouds filling the rest of the frame
shots.motion_elements: the layered clouds and the heather

shots.subject: The rim of a long plateau escarpment dusted with new snow, the cliff edge curving away into the distance above a wide valley far below
shots.composition: Standing near the rim looking along the escarpment edge as it curves away, the snowy plateau on the left and the drop with the valley on the right
shots.motion_elements: the drifting clouds over the valley

shots.subject: A broad late-winter upland slope where snow patches are retreating, a low mat of dwarf willow twigs with silver buds near the camera, brown grass between the snow and a white rounded summit beyond
shots.composition: Camera low beside the willow mat, which fills the lower left third of the frame, the patchy snow slope rising across the middle and the white summit on the horizon
shots.motion_elements: the willow twigs, the brown grass and the thin high clouds
